# pinyin-pro

Pinned version: 3.29.5 (MIT).

Official source: https://github.com/zh-lx/pinyin-pro

`pinyin-pro/` contains the unmodified `dist/esm/` files from the npm package
`pinyin-pro@3.29.5`. `pinyin-pro.mjs` re-exports its ESM entry point.
`pinyin-pro.LICENSE` preserves the upstream license.

The static build adds a content-version query to local imports, without changing
library behavior. No remote script or pinyin API is loaded at runtime.
